# Puppet Desk 1.9.0

This release introduces installation licensing and restores the public app from
maintenance. Read and accept the licence agreement before registration. Puppet
Desk is licensed, not sold; the agreement explains licence suspension/revocation,
what licensing data is sent, and how to request review. Artwork remains yours.

> We reserve the right to suspend or revoke a Puppet Desk licence at our discretion, for any reason, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Read the [full licence agreement](https://github.com/anonimations696/Puppet-Desk/blob/main/EULA.txt). Mandatory legal rights remain intact.

**Application build: 85.**

- Licence checks run when Puppet Desk opens (including after an update) or when
  you choose Check now. There are no every-minute or network-return checks.
- Public installations need a successful first registration. After registration,
  a last-known active licence works offline without an expiry countdown.
- A received revocation remains saved offline. A newly issued status reaches the
  app at its next online startup/manual check. Restoration also requires a check.
- Mode > Licence status shows your installation's number and current status.
- The Back view adds one image per puppet and its own assignable hotkey (F9 by
  default). It has no talking/blinking frames and has its own hand library.

The licensing service must be available for new registrations and status changes.
A service outage does not revoke an existing licence or erase artwork/settings.
Development and Public have separate licences. Administration is not included in
Public. This update does not remotely alter copies that have not installed it.

Close Puppet Desk and run Update Puppet Desk. For a first installation, download
Install-Puppet-Desk.exe from this release; it installs both the app and its updater.
